sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Welcome to Simulator 7.8 Tab A: the Intersectional Subgroup and Wilson Whiskers Studio. Adjust the Female-Dark error rate, slice sample size, and baseline error rate. Watch the 95% Wilson confidence intervals expand dramatically for sparse slices. Notice how evaluating intersectional slices reveals hidden disparities that aggregate metrics completely obscure.

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Let's test intersectional disaggregation and Wilson whiskers live! Drag the slice sample size down to 40 and watch the error whiskers stretch across the chart! Notice on the live audit cards how aggregate parity can look acceptable while the dark female intersectional slice fails audit thresholds!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Let us test your statistical rigor in Active Checkpoint 1. In a facial recognition audit of darker-skinned female subjects with sample size n equals 20, exactly k equals 8 classification errors are observed. Using z equals 1.96 for a 95% confidence level, calculate the exact Wilson score confidence interval.

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Time for Checkpoint 1! Apply Edwin Wilson's quadratic score interval formula for n equals 20 and k equals 8! Compute the center shifted toward one-half and the asymmetric margin of error! Which interval correctly bounds the true population error rate?

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Correct! With empirical proportion p-hat equals 0.40, the Wilson denominator is 1 plus 3.8416 over 20, giving 1.1921. The center is 0.40 plus 3.8416 over 40, divided by 1.1921, which yields 0.4161. The margin of error evaluates to 0.1973, producing the exact 95% Wilson interval of [0.219, 0.613]. Notice how this avoids the severe undercoverage of the normal Wald approximation.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Incorrect. The Wilson score formula centers at p-hat plus z-squared over 2n, all divided by 1 plus z-squared over n. With n equals 20, k equals 8, and z equals 1.96, the denominator is 1.1921, the center is 0.4161, and the margin is 0.1973, yielding bounds [0.219, 0.613].

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Welcome to Simulator 7.8 Tab B: the Automated MLOps CI/CD Disparity Pipeline Gates Studio. Toggle candidate model metrics and audit thresholds across four automated gating stages: Disparate Impact Ratio, Intersectional Equalized Odds, Minimax Subgroup Risk, and Datasheet Provenance. A candidate model is cleared for canary deployment if and only if every single gate passes simultaneously under strict logical conjunction.

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Let's run the automated fairness CI/CD deployment pipeline! Adjust the candidate model's disparate impact ratio and equalized odds gap against the gating thresholds! Watch the pipeline status cards update in real time: if even a single disparity gate fails, deployment is automatically halted and rollouts are blocked!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Let us evaluate your MLOps production gating judgment in Active Checkpoint 2. A production CI/CD fairness pipeline enforces four automated gates: Disparate Impact Ratio at least 0.80, Equalized Odds gap at most 0.10, Minimax Subgroup Risk at most 0.25, and a cryptographically certified Datasheet. A candidate model achieves DIR of 0.76, EO gap of 0.06, worst-case risk of 0.19, and valid Datasheet. What is the pipeline deployment decision?

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Checkpoint 2 tests your automated release policy! The candidate model passes three out of four gates, but its disparate impact ratio is 0.76, falling below the 0.80 four-fifths rule threshold! Under strict logical conjunction, does the pipeline deploy to canary or halt the build?

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Correct! Automated release gates enforce strict logical conjunction: every single gate must evaluate to true. Because the candidate model's Disparate Impact Ratio of 0.76 violates the four-fifths threshold of 0.80, Gate 1 fails, triggering an immediate non-zero exit code that halts the CI/CD pipeline and blocks canary deployment.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Incorrect. Production fairness gating requires strict logical conjunction across all four criteria. Even though the model satisfies Equalized Odds, Minimax Risk, and Datasheet certification, its Disparate Impact Ratio of 0.76 fails the 0.80 threshold. A single failed gate mandates immediate build rejection.
